mode.title: Mode
mode.description: What to extract. 'productSearch' = product listings by keyword or category (with price, discount, promo, stock). 'categoryTree' = the full category hierarchy. 'promoBanners' = homepage promo banners plus the promo-type filters. 'searchSuggestions' = popular keywords and recommendations. 'stores' = resolve store/area info for one or more district IDs.

searchTerms.title: Search terms
searchTerms.description: productSearch mode. Keywords to sweep, e.g. ["indomie", "susu"]. Each is paged until exhausted or Max items. If left empty and no Category IDs are given, the run falls back to the keyword 'indomie'.

categoryIds.title: Category IDs
categoryIds.description: productSearch mode. Category IDs to list products for (get them from a 'categoryTree' run's `id` field). Combined with searchTerms if both are given.

storeCode.title: Store code
storeCode.description: Optional. The Indomaret Xpress store to scope catalog data to (e.g. 'TJKT'). Leave empty to resolve automatically from District ID. Everything on this site is store-scoped (click-and-collect).

districtId.title: District ID
districtId.description: Optional. Indonesian district (kecamatan) ID used to resolve the nearest store when Store code is empty. Defaults to 141100100 (Gambir, Jakarta Pusat).

districtIds.title: District IDs (stores mode)
districtIds.description: stores mode only. One or more district IDs to resolve store/area info for.

latitude.title: Latitude
latitude.description: Optional. Latitude for the store context. Auto-resolved from the store/district when empty.

longitude.title: Longitude
longitude.description: Optional. Longitude for the store context. Auto-resolved from the store/district when empty.

maxItems.title: Max items
maxItems.description: Stop after this many records (per query in productSearch mode). 0 means no limit -- scrape until the source is exhausted.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Klikindomaret is behind Cloudflare + AWS WAF. Apify Residential proxy with country 'ID' is recommended for reliability; short runs often succeed without a proxy.
